summary: Backend work partially implements per-market HTTP fetch methods and allowlists, but the diff does not show explicit non-HTTPS rejection, does not show any changes to the legacy arbitrary fetchExternalData safety model, and does not show the required `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` method to fix the deployment-blocking actor API mismatch. Additionally, substantial frontend feature/UI work was added that was not requested for this Step 2 build.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reject (trap) any per-market fetch call using a non-HTTPS URL with a clear error message, and ensure per-market methods can only call their own allowlisted endpoints (no open proxy).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows per-market allowlist checks, but does not show any explicit validation that the provided URL is HTTPS (e.g., checking for the "https://" scheme). A `type HTTPSUrl = Text` alias does not enforce HTTPS at runtime.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update/replace `fetchExternalData(url : Text)` so it is no longer a general-purpose arbitrary-URL fetch; enforce HTTPS + allowlist (or remove/admin-only), and ensure the deployed backend Candid interface matches implementation.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff does not show `fetchExternalData` being removed or restricted, nor any allowlist enforcement being added to it, nor any explicit interface alignment changes; the shown backend changes only add new per-market methods and allowlists.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix backend/frontend actor API mismatch by exposing a public method `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(adminToken)` (or otherwise make initialization compatible without modifying immutable frontend paths).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff includes documentation describing the missing method, but the shown backend code does not include an implementation/exposure of `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`. No other compatibility shim is evidenced in the diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a local frontend type system and multiple new/updated UI components and hooks for asset search, market type selection, add holding flow, static asset catalog, and portfolio mocks.
hallucinated_features.reason: Step 2 request focuses on backend verified HTTP outcalls with allowlists and fixing a deploy-breaking actor API mismatch; it explicitly lists UI modernization/design-system changes and broader frontend enhancements as out of scope/non-goals.

hallucinated_features.description: Added deployment failure analysis and rebuild checklist documentation files.
hallucinated_features.reason: Documentation additions were not requested as part of REQ-6/7/8/9 deliverables.
